info.title: Microsoft.EdgeOperator - Azure Local Disconnected Operations system readiness
info.description: Microsoft.EdgeOperator Resource Provider management API for Azure Local Disconnected Operations (ALDO) system readiness.

get.description: Gets the Azure Local Disconnected Operations (ALDO) system readiness status.

ErrorMessageDetail.description: The error messages reported for a single readiness category. Messages are present when the category is not ready and a specific error is available.

categoryName.description: The name of the readiness category (for example, `services`, `diagnostics`, `identity`, `networking`).

errorMessageDetails.description: The list of error messages reported for the category. Present when the category is not ready and a specific error is available; otherwise empty.

ReadinessStatusDetail.description: The readiness percentage reported for a single readiness category.

categoryName.description: The name of the readiness category (for example, `services`, `diagnostics`, `identity`, `networking`).

readinessPercentage.description: The readiness percentage reported by the category, from 0 (not ready) to 100 (fully ready).

SystemReadiness.description:
The system readiness status for Azure Local Disconnected Operations (ALDO).
Reports whether the ALDO system is ready. This is a read-only singleton resource — the only
accepted resource name is `default`.

The subscription in the request path must be the Operator subscription. This subscription is used
only for the access check: the resource provider verifies it on every request, and only operators
have access to the Operator subscription and can therefore invoke the Microsoft.EdgeOperator APIs.
Requests scoped to any other subscription are rejected.

properties.description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

SystemReadinessProperties.description:
The readiness state of the Azure Local Disconnected Operations (ALDO) system.
All fields are computed by the resource provider and are read-only.

systemReady.description: Indicates whether the system is ready. `true` when every readiness category has reported 100 percent.

readinessStatusDetails.description: The readiness percentage reported for each readiness category.

errorMessages.description: The error messages reported for each readiness category. A category presents messages when it is not ready and a specific error is available.
